hooks.name: a11y-lighthouse-on-build
hooks.description: After the agent runs npm run build, run scripts/audit.mjs (Lighthouse mobile and desktop plus axe via Playwright in normal and reduced motion, against dist/) and print reports/summary.md for the agent. Exit 1 with the failure output if the audit errors or axe finds a serious or critical violation. Script: scripts/hooks/a11y-lighthouse-on-build.mjs.
